evals.name: bootstrap-map-for-vague-reports
evals.prompt: 우리 웹앱 기능맵 좀 만들어줘. 운영팀에서 '사이드바에 뭐가 잘 안돼요', '입금 문구가 잘 입력이 안돼요' 이런 식으로 말하는데, 그때 AI가 바로 어디 코드인지 찾을 수 있으면 좋겠어.
evals.expected_output: A new docs/FEATURES.md following assets/feature-map-template-ko.md: header with the verified short SHA and date; a lookup protocol section first; a screen index mapping regions (e.g. the sidebar) to feature IDs; an alias index that keeps Korean/English and colloquial terms (입금, deposit, 충전, 입금 문구) and marks collisions as (ambiguous); and per-feature entries with location, aliases, literal UI strings copied verbatim with i18n keys, a UI → state → API → server → data code path, tests (or explicit none), and pitfalls each citing a commit or code source. Features are discovered from routes, layouts, nav config, and i18n files rather than the directory tree. Every path exists and every literal string greps in the source. The assistant proposes a one-line pointer for CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md instead of silently editing it, and does not commit.

evals.name: update-mode-from-recorded-sha
evals.prompt: docs/FEATURES.md 만든 지 좀 됐는데 그 사이에 결제 화면이랑 알림 설정이 바뀌었어. 기능맵 최신화해줘.
evals.expected_output: The assistant reads the recorded SHA from the existing map's header and runs git diff --name-only <sha>..HEAD, re-verifies only entries whose files appear in the diff, adds entries for new routes/screens/UI strings found in the diff, removes or fixes paths and literal strings that no longer exist, and leaves untouched entries as they were. The header SHA and date are updated. If the recorded SHA is unreachable, it says so and re-verifies every path rather than silently regenerating. The report lists which entries were added, changed, and removed.

evals.name: no-invented-pitfalls-and-split
evals.prompt: 기능이 40개 넘는 큰 프로젝트인데 기능맵 만들어줘. 자주 터지는 부분도 같이 적어줘.
evals.expected_output: Because the project exceeds ~30 features, docs/FEATURES.md holds only the lookup protocol plus screen and alias indexes, and each feature entry lives in docs/features/<feature-id>.md with stable kebab-case IDs. Pitfalls appear only where a commit (found via git log --grep fix on the feature's files), a code comment, or a defensive guard supports them, each citing that source; features without evidence have no pitfall rather than a plausible guess. Features without tests say tests: none.
